source: TradingView Official CAPITALCOM 15m OHLCV and original TradingView CAPITAL MTF alerts; retrospective data may differ

methodology.original_decision_fields: alert-time OHLC EMA20 EMA50 RSI14 ATR14 when available; otherwise later chart historical
methodology.warning: EMA200/ADX/zscore reconstructed from later OHLCV; not promotion grade; source revision possible
methodology.ema_method: causal EMA smoothing alpha=2/(n+1), warmup 700 bars, seeded at first close
methodology.adx_method: Wilder14 smoothed directional movement and true range; first14 DX average then Wilder
methodology.cost_limit: bps ladder is a sensitivity proxy; not verified instrument-specific spread/slippage/commission
